messages.author: b25e9f57ea867301
messages.subject: Re: geom_ribbon custom error bars (beginner question)
parts:
thank you for your reply.

I finally fixed my problem and here is the proper code. Interestingly
those ymax and min are correct.

x<- x + geom_point(aes(colour = comparing))
x<- x + scale_x_continuous("# background genomes")
x<- x + scale_y_continuous("-log10 genome permutation (P value)")
x<- x + geom_abline(intercept=-1*log10(2.4e-6), slope=0,
color="red",size=1.5, linetype=2)
x<- x + expand_limits(y=c(0,9))
x<- x + opts(title="Comparing Target Files")
x<- x + geom_text(aes(y=-1*log10(5e-8), x=50, label="-1*log10(2.4e-6):
genome sig."))
x<- x + geom_ribbon(aes(x=total$Background.Genomes, ymin = -log10(total
$CI.L.genome.permutation),ymax = -log10(total
$CI.H.geonome.permutation), fill=(total$comparing)), alpha=.2)


}

messages.subject: Re: geom_ribbon custom error bars (beginner question)
parts:
Note that you should never see $ in your aes calls. You want:

geom_ribbon(aes(x = Background.Genomes,
ymin = -log10(CI.L.genome.permutation),
ymax = -log10(CI.H.geonome.permutation), fill=comparing), alpha=.2)

Hadley
